column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: XSRF-TOKEN is read by the front end by design)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: the public API is read-only, credential-free and CORS * on purpose)
(Sub Resource Integrity: font CSS is generated per request by the font CDN)
(CSP: style-src 'unsafe-inline' and img-src https: are accepted; scripts are nonce-locked)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens: the CI target is served over http and GET search forms carry no state)
